steps.text: Reach SUSPECTED on a discovery (keep experimenting).
CONFIRM a discovery (70% knowledge, or gather evidence).
Make your first deal: acquire a lab, sign a contract, build, hire, or run an op.

tour.title: Run an experiment
tour.detail: Open Experiments, pick OBSERVE (safe, cheap) with any scientist, and run it. Knowledge starts moving and the discovery stirs.

tour.title: Reach SUSPECTED
tour.detail: Keep experimenting on the same artifact until knowledge passes 30%. The artifact's story text changes — that is the narrative noticing you.

tour.title: CONFIRM the discovery
tour.detail: Push knowledge to 70% or chain evidence events. Confirmation unlocks a technology — pick one that fits how you want to win.

tour.title: Spend the technology
tour.detail: Open Technology and unlock. Resonance for market muscle, Cryo for safety, Deep Field for discovery speed.

tour.title: Make a deal
tour.detail: Sign a contract, acquire a lab, build, hire, or run an op. Deals are the other half of victory — and a $500 training grant is waiting when this lands.
